title: How It Works
subtitle: Download Pinterest content in 3 simple steps

steps.title: Copy Pinterest URL
steps.description: Find the Pinterest video or image you want to download. Copy the URL from your browser's address bar or use the share button to copy the link.

steps.title: Paste URL
steps.description: Paste the Pinterest URL into our download box above and click the Download button. Our servers will instantly fetch the content.

steps.title: Download Content
steps.description: Choose your preferred quality and format, then click download. Your file will be saved to your device in seconds.

contentTypes.description: Download Pinterest videos in HD quality. Supports all video formats including MP4.
Save Pinterest images in original quality. Perfect for designers and content creators.

contentTypes.title: GIFs & Animations
contentTypes.description: Download animated GIFs and Pinterest animations with ease.

tips.solution: Make sure you've copied the complete Pinterest URL. The URL should start with https://www.pinterest.com/
Try selecting a higher quality option from the download menu. Some videos may only be available in certain qualities.
The content might be private or deleted. Try refreshing the Pinterest page and copying the URL again.
Check your internet connection. Large files may take longer to download depending on your connection speed.
